item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Montana man kills 8 family members during Sunday dinner, police say
item.description: A Montana man killed eight relatives, including four children, during a family gathering before setting the home on fire and later dying, police said.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] PSTA could cut 2 Pinellas transit services, raise some fares despite balanced budget
item.description: Pinellas County transit leaders are set to decide Wednesday whether to eliminate two PSTA services and increase some fares after riders packed a public hearing last week to argue that the value of public transportation cannot always be measured by ridership and cost alone.
